structured.reason: The description addresses a coverage complaint raised in the reviews, which the criterion treats as a negative signal even when defensive. Reviews say "Completely sheer not good at all," "you can barely tell it's been painted," and "Most of the colors you have to put several coats." The description responds with "has a thick, durable formula designed to coat even dark nails." The hedging word "designed to" also reads as a qualified claim about performance rather than a pure positive. Under the strict standard, where any doubt should fail, this is a fail.
